extraction_notes: Vendor did not provide a per-SKU price list; pricing is given entirely as category/bracket rules based on ply and size, plus a heavy-duty/pallet surcharge and a volume discount - these cannot be reliably mapped to specific SKUs without further calculation, so no line_items were extracted. The phrase "rest same as last year, freight extra" is vague - "rest" presumably refers to sizes/brackets not explicitly priced (e.g. very large sizes), but the actual legacy prices were not provided in this document, so this is a gap. Quality/ISO certificates were promised separately but not included ("our guy is on leave this week") - no certification data available. No MOQ, lead time, payment terms, defect rate, or recycled content info given.
